hero.lead: Grow your districts, pick roles with special powers and grab city projects before your rivals do.
hero.pillarsLabel: What the game is made of
hero.districtsText: Buy buildings, strengthen your district and unlock unique bonuses that help you grow faster than everyone else.
hero.rolesText: Build your strategy around your role — or pick a different one when the situation calls for it. Roles can change hands during the game, and you can fight other players for them.
hero.projectsText: Take part in city projects to earn more victory points and bonuses that keep working for you until the end of the game.
hero.greyText: Take risks, get resources and get in your rivals' way. Failed deals can bring you scandals.

about.title: About the project
about.p1: Hi! City of Influence is my own board game. I make it in my free time, and my dream is to see it one day as a real box on the table.
about.p2: : no ads and no paid advantages. Everyone plays on equal terms. If you like the project and want to support it, you can do it on Patreon or Boosty.
about.p4: Found a bug, something is unclear, or you have an idea? Write to me on the feedback page — I read every message.
about.lead: A board game I am making myself

feedback.title: Share what you think of the game
feedback.lead: Here you can report a bug, share an idea or just tell me how you like the game. I read every message. Leave a contact and I will try to reply.
feedback.support: Like the project? You can support it — the money goes to printing the board game.

bug.title: Report a bug
bug.hint: Something is broken or works wrong
bug.placeholder: What happened, and what did you do just before? If you remember, name the round, the role or the card.

idea.placeholder: What would you add to the game or do differently?

other.title: Other
other.placeholder: Write it just as it is — I really want to know.

feedback.note: We also send the game version and your browser type — it helps to find bugs.

feedback.doneTitle: Thank you! Your message was sent.
feedback.doneText: It really helps to make the game better.

about.boris: Builds income and money, never attacks

supportDialog.title: Support the project
supportDialog.lead: Thank you for wanting to help
supportDialog.p1: City of Influence is free and will stay free: no ads and no paid advantages. If you like the game and want to help, support the project on Patreon or Boosty — any amount.
supportDialog.p2: All the money will go to printing the first batch of the board game: the cards, the board and the box.
